name: Mumbai Police
license_or_status: non-free logo (en.wikipedia; file page licence: Fair use)
notes: Blue star badge reading 'GREATER MUMBAI POLICE' round the scales of justice, with 'Brihanmumbai Police' in Marathi, the motto 'Sadrakshanaya Khalanigrahanaya' on a ribbon and the national emblem on top; the file page cites mumbaipolice.maharashtra.gov.in, and the force's site (mumbaipolice.gov.in) uses the same design as its header logo. Also stands for Mumbai Traffic Police, which has no separate mark on file (its site header shows only the State Emblem). Only 282x268 at source. Dark blue artwork on transparent: needs a light plate on dark grounds. Contains the State Emblem of India, whose use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005

name: Maharashtra Police
license_or_status: non-free logo (en.wikipedia; file page licence: Fair use)
notes: The force's insignia (vector): a white five-pointed star outlined in blue with an open palm at its centre, 'Maharashtra Police' in Marathi above and the motto 'Sadrakshanaya Khalanigrahanaya' on a ribbon below; the file page cites mahapolice.gov.in, whose header shows the same insignia. The CC0 'uniform patch' redrawing on Commons (a 6.5 MB SVG) was not used. Blue lettering on transparent: needs a light plate on dark grounds

name: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation
license_or_status: CC BY 4.0 as stated on Wikimedia Commons (author given as Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, source mcgm.gov.in); the file is listed for deletion on Commons (deletion requests, August 2026), so treat the licence claim as doubtful
notes: The corporation's round seal: its coat of arms (a lion crest over a shield quartered with the Gateway of India, an industry wheel, ships and a domed building, the motto 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah' and a lotus) on a cream disc with a gold rim, with its Marathi name above and 'Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation' below. Also stands for BMC Disaster Management (1916). 1266x1266 at source. Reads on any ground

name: Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority
license_or_status: public domain as stated on Wikimedia Commons (PD-textlogo); logo of MMRDA
notes: Green and blue bar mark beside 'MMRDA' in Devanagari and Latin letters (vector); the same file is served by the MMRDA metro operator's site (mmmocl.co.in/assets/images/mmrda-logo.svg). Dark blue lettering: needs a light plate on dark grounds

name: National Disaster Management Authority
license_or_status: non-free logo (en.wikipedia; file page licence: Fair use)
notes: Circular NDMA seal with the map of India inside a gold cog ring; reads on any ground

name: NDMA Sachet (National Disaster Alert Portal)
license_or_status: official website logo file (sachet.ndma.gov.in); no licence stated
notes: White 'Sachet / National Disaster Alert Portal' wordmark from the portal header. Not on Commons or en.wikipedia. White artwork: needs a dark plate on light grounds

name: India Meteorological Department
license_or_status: non-free logo (en.wikipedia; file page licence: Fair use)
notes: IMD seal (globe with weather map) with the national emblem on top. The dark emblem fades on a near-black ground, so it gets a light plate. Contains the State Emblem of India, whose use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005

name: BEST Undertaking
license_or_status: non-free logo (en.wikipedia; file page licence: Fair use)
notes: Red roundel with a bus inside a light-bulb outline over 'BEST' in Devanagari: the mark of the Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport Undertaking (electricity and buses). Only 184x225 at source; the undertaking's own site (bestundertaking.com) serves a smaller 100x100 copy. Reads on dark and light grounds

name: Indian Railways (Central Railway)
license_or_status: official website logo file (cr.indianrailways.gov.in); no licence stated; logo of Indian Railways
notes: Red Indian Railways roundel ('Bharatiya Rail' and 'INDIAN RAILWAYS' round a locomotive bearing the national emblem). Central Railway has no zone logo of its own: its site header shows this Indian Railways logo, and Western Railway's site serves a byte-identical file, so the cr and wr rows share indian-railways.png. The only zone-specific files on Commons are user-drawn renderings of the 'CR' / 'WR' stencil codes painted on rolling stock, which were not used. 1596x1596 at source. Reads on any ground. Contains the State Emblem of India, whose use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005

name: Indian Railways (Western Railway)
license_or_status: official website logo file (wr.indianrailways.gov.in); no licence stated; logo of Indian Railways
notes: The same Indian Railways roundel as the cr row (one file, indian-railways.png): Western Railway's site header shows the Indian Railways logo, byte-identical to Central Railway's, and the zone has no logo of its own. Reads on any ground. Contains the State Emblem of India, whose use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005

name: Maha Mumbai Metro Operation Corporation (Maha Mumbai Metro)
license_or_status: official website logo file (mmmocl.co.in); no licence stated; Wikimedia Commons hosts the same mark as a 225x225 raster (File:Maha_Mumbai_Metro.png) tagged PD-textlogo + trademarked
notes: Green geometric emblem beside 'Maha Mumbai Metro' in Devanagari and Latin letters (vector): the mark of Maha Mumbai Metro Operation Corporation Ltd, the MMRDA metro operating company that runs Lines 2A and 7. It stands for Mumbai Metro as a whole; Line 1 (Metro One) and Line 3 (Aqua Line, run by MMRCL) have their own operators and marks, not on file. The operator's vector was used over the Commons raster because it is transparent and scalable. Dark blue lettering: needs a light plate on dark grounds

name: Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation
license_or_status: non-free logo (en.wikipedia; file page licence: Fair use)
notes: Grey and white arcs on a red square, the logo the file page credits to the corporation's former site msrdc.org (that domain now hosts an unrelated site). LOW RESOLUTION: only 75x75 at source (kept at native size). Not on Commons; the corporation's current site (msrdc.in) failed a TLS host-name check, so nothing was fetched from it. Opaque square, reads on any ground

name: Mumbai Port Authority
license_or_status: official website logo file (mumbaiport.gov.in); no licence stated
notes: Blue round seal reading 'Mumbai Port Authority' and its Devanagari name round four roundels (a lighthouse and ships), dated 1873. Not on Commons or en.wikipedia (Commons only has photos of the old Bombay Port Trust mark). LOW RESOLUTION: only 120x120 at source (kept at native size). The white ground outside the seal was made transparent by a flood fill from the corners; the seal itself is untouched. Fetched over plain HTTP because the HTTPS site does not send a complete certificate chain. Reads on any ground

name: OpenStreetMap
license_or_status: CC BY-SA 3.0 + trademarked (Wikimedia Commons); trademark of the OpenStreetMap Foundation
notes: Magnifying glass over a folded map (vector). OSM map data itself is ODbL and needs its own credit

name: Open-Meteo
license_or_status: official website icon file (open-meteo.com; the site's source repository open-meteo/open-meteo-website is AGPL-3.0); no separate logo licence stated
notes: Orange rounded square with 'om', the site's own app icon (512x512 at source). Not on Commons or en.wikipedia. The GitHub organisation avatar was not used because it sets the mark on a photo

name: Copernicus
license_or_status: CC BY-SA 3.0 (as stated on Wikimedia Commons, source given as the European Commission; the Copernicus logo is an EU mark, so treat the licence claim as doubtful)
notes: 'Copernicus - Europe's eyes on Earth' wordmark (2015), the EU Earth observation programme. Only 240x88 at source (kept at native size; en.wikipedia's larger file is an opaque white tile with the EU flag). Dark blue text: needs a light plate on dark grounds

name: Cesium
license_or_status: official website logo file (cesium.com; a trademark of Cesium GS, Inc.); no licence stated
notes: Cesium logomark (vector) on its own white disc, so it reads on any ground
